subject: Chemistry
section: Introduction Three important characteristics of chemical reactions include : extent of reaction, feasibility and its rate. In standard XI, we learnt how equibrium constants predict the extent of reaction. In unit 3 of this textbook, we learnt how thermodynamic properties such as change in entropy or enthalpy tell us whether under the given set of conditions the chemical reaction represented by a chemical equation occurs or not. Chemical kinetics is a branch of chemistry which deals with the rate of chemical reactions and the factors those affect them.
